test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order. apart from generating**

P. real income for players, play-to-earn

Q. games also create communities

R. where gamers and creators can meet, share

S. wisdom, and do deals with one another
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph discusses the impact and benefits of play-to-earn games.
 
• **Sentence P is the first sentence** as it introduces the idea of generating real income for players:
 
 
• "Apart from generating real income for players, play-to-earn..."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q follows** as it highlights the community-building aspect of such games:
 
 
• "...games also create communities..."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R is the third sentence** as it elaborates on the interactions within these communities:
 
 
• "...where gamers and creators can meet, share..."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the fourth** as it completes the idea with the benefits of collaboration and deals:
 
 
• "...wisdom, and do deals with one another."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **PQRS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement:**

"Apart from generating real income for players, play-to-earn games also create communities where gamers and creators can meet, share wisdom, and do deals with one another."
